owner_verdict: Checkpoint09 was useful, more-than-incremental and efficient progress, but it did not complete the visual-twin mission.
current_acceptance: Source likeness remains unmet; technical success and completed supervised loops do not substitute for owner artistic acceptance.

findings.status: confirmed from actual sources and matched renders
findings.cause: Large source-defining forms remain different: broad pale cranial slab, sparse/disconnected cheek and orbit, long or puffy simplified breast surfaces, flat cover-like toes and smooth claws.
findings.implication: More surface detail or preserved mesh counts cannot compensate for these forms.

findings.cause: HEAD01 targeted nearby brow courses while another visible mesh, CGH17 frontal crown root, creates the dominant slab. The new overlay introduced optic-readability cost.
findings.implication: Identify actual visible contributors before constructing a coupled successor; retire exact stored surfaces explicitly.

findings.status: confirmed for the finish trials; broader implication inferred
findings.cause: The first finish trial used OBJECT material bindings that evaluated meshes ignored. The second repaired DATA bindings but changed already-dark palettes modestly while geometry stayed exact.
findings.implication: Prove effective bindings, then judge the whole image. Stop polish that does not materially improve source likeness.

findings.status: inference supported by prior and current review separation
findings.cause: Preservation, successful builds, embedded maps and plentiful meshes establish delivery mechanics; they do not measure likeness. Isolated regional improvements can worsen whole-head readability.
findings.implication: Matched whole views, three-role independent review and decisive ablation govern retention. BODY01 alone survives; HEAD01 and FINISH01 do not.

findings.cause: Inactive worktree accumulation left the host Data volume effectively full and interrupted final renders.
findings.implication: Recoverable archival preserved old work and restored15GiB; check storage alongside time/tokens before dispatch.

findings.cause: Source depth and camera registration are estimated from optimizer-seen images; there is no protected holdout or physical calibration.
findings.implication: Use visible source views as artistic evidence and label inferred hidden construction. Preserve approved stance anchors; do not claim exact 3D reconstruction or engineering validity.
